description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Role' that provides role-based access control for views, including methods for access checking, route alteration, options configuration, and cache management.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class providing role-based access control for views, implementing cache dependency interface and methods for access logic, route alteration, options form, and dependency calculation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the role storage dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the user account has any of the specified roles.

methods.name: alterRouteDefinition
methods.description: Modifies route requirements to include role-based access.

methods.name: summaryTitle
methods.description: Returns a summary string of the selected roles.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including roles.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for selecting roles.

methods.name: validateOptionsForm
methods.description: Validates the role selection in the options form.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies based on selected roles.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age as permanent.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts related to user roles.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags, empty in this case.
